You start with likely ailments and attempt to rule them out by process of elimination, making an educated probabilistic guess as to the cause and try to prescribe the treatment with the best cost/benefit ratio, if/when the treatment is ineffective you try the next most likely cause and so on. Friday night I didn't sleep well. My morning sickness (which is really more like "all-day sickness") had returned, and was keeping me up. Couple that with the fact that I generally have a tough time sleeping when I'm not in my own bed, this meant I had a hard time falling asleep. I finally dozed off sometime after midnight. At about 12:30, I heard somebody out in the hall, in a high-pitched baby voice say: "no kitty, be quiet! Go back downstairs! You can't go in there! OK I'll pet you." This ridiculousness went on for a few minutes, and then I heard my parents' bedroom door open, and then close again. I wasn't able to fall asleep for another hour, and was woken up again around 6:30 to begin getting ready for the wedding.

I'm not a morning person. I'm especially not a morning person when I barely slept and feel like I have to puke. I went downstairs, where my mom was sitting with the bridesmaids, the make-up artist, and the hair stylist. "How did you sleep?" she asked me. "Like absolute shit," I said. "Some idiot decided 12:30 this morning would be a great time to have a conversation with the cat." "Oh, that was me," says Hamderella. "The cat was outside your parents door crying, I didn't want her to wake anyone up." I glared at her and snapped, "well, I didn't hear the cat, I only heard you." My mom, the natural mediator, tried to diffuse the situation. "It's OK, she just wanted to come sleep with your father and me. I let her into our room and {The Fat Bridesmaid} went back to bed." I was displeased, but decided to let it go. It was going to be a long day, and I needed to save my energy for the important stuff.

The make-up artist had set up her chair in front of the big bay window in the main room. The chair itself sort of looked like this but was made of wood. It's The Fat Bridesmaid's turn to get her make-up done, and she glances nervously at the chair. "What's the weight limit on that thing?" she asks the make-up artist. "Oh, it's about 300 lbs," she replies. The Fat Bridesmaid doesn't say anything, she just stands there glaring at it, as if she were sizing it up and determining whether or not to tempt fate. "Don't worry about it," says the make-up artist. "It'll be fine." The Fat Bridesmaid gets into the chair, and her ass is spilling out on all sides. Thank God I hadn't eaten yet at that point, or else I would have certainly puked it back up. Somehow, the chair survived her gargantuan weight, and she plopped down on the couch beside me when the MUA was finished.

The Fat Bridesmaid begins complaining about how hungry she is. My dad is going to make us all breakfast, but he is currently out getting a few last-minute things for the day. My mom explained that he would be back soon to start making us breakfast, but Hamderella just whines that she's hungry nnnnooooooowwwwwwwww!!! Keep in mind that she's a guest in my parents' home, and has been acting like an entitled brat the whole time. "Well, there's some fruit in the fridge if you want," my mom suggests. Hamderella declines, and sits there pouting like a child.

Not getting the attention she wanted, she then starts to complain about how her knees hurt, and today is going to be such a long day, she's not sure how she's going to get through it. My younger sister (also a bridesmaid) chimes in and says that she's been having knee issues as well. My sister had to have major reconstructive knee surgery on both knees about 10 years ago to fix a congenital defect, and the surgical pins that were placed at the time have been giving her trouble the past few months. They've actually been rubbing up against the inside of her skin, and it's been very painful for her. They need to be removed, but she isn't able to see a specialist about it until December.

Again, not to be outdone, The Fat Bridesmaid minimalizes my sister's condition, stating, "oh, well you're skinny. Your knees aren't as bad as mine. I've got an extra 50 lbs walking around on them." Yeah right, Hammy, try an extra 100. Maybe even 150, I can't be sure. Hamderella proceeds to go on about how it's going to be so hard to walk around all day, and that she's in so much pain, she can't even exercise anymore (doubt she even did to begin with). Not to pass up a prime shitlording opportunity, I pipe up: "even if you can't exercise, it's diet that's important. If your weight is affecting your knees, start watching your calories and eat less. Diet is 80% of the solution when it comes to losing weight."

Hamderella scowls at me. She at least suspects I'm a shitlady, though maybe she doesn't know exactly how deep my hatred runs, especially for her. "Oh, I know it's diet," she says to me. "I just like food too much and I'm lazy. I could lose weight if I wanted to. When I did want to, I lost 32 pounds in 3 months!" Way to deflect, fatty. Classic ham tactic. Make it seem like you're that big because you want to be. I guess this would be why you didn't lose any weight and had to order a larger dress size, despite insisting you would be "motivated to lose weight" for my sister's wedding. I don't know if fatty was seeking my approval or just deflecting with her comment, but I didn't give her the satisfaction. I glared down my nose at her, went "Hmph" and changed the subject.

After everyone is finished with hair, make-up, and getting dressed, the photographer showed up at my parents' house to take a few photos before we got into the limo and went to the church. He lined us all up across the walk-way in front of my parents' house to take a few pictures with the house in the background. My sister (the bride) is in the middle of the walkway, with me and my other sister on either side of her. The other 2 bridesmaids were beside my other sister, and Hamderella was directed to stand beside me. Well, at least she's on the outside, we can crop her out of the photos with relative ease. Hamderella was standing there, and must have shifted her massive weight, because without warning, she goes down. She grabs onto my arm, and almost drags 3-and-half-months-pregnant me down with her. My mom immediately came rushing over to me to make sure I was OK. My sisters are also concerned with my safety at this point. "I'm fine too," The Fat Bridesmaid snaps as she stands up, sounding butthurt that everyone was fussing over me who didn't actually fall, insead of her. I just glared at her, and reassured everyone that I was OK.

The ceremony was beautiful. Despite being in a church, my sister and her husband had opted for a non-religious ceremony, so it was only about half an hour long. After the ceremony, the bridal party was directed outside for some photos with the fall foliage before we took off in the limo for more formal ones. It was somewhat overcast, and 11 degrees Celsius outside (that's about 52 degrees in Freedom units). Everyone, including the bride, was wearing a floor-length dress, but they were all sleeveless. Needless to say, we were all a bit chilly. The Fat Bridesmaid proudly exclaimed, "see? This is where I have the advantage over you skinny girls!" I scoffed and whispered to my husband "yeah, and that's the only advantage." He let out a chuckle, and Hamderella went bright red. I'm not sure if she actually heard me, or if she was just embarassed because nobody acknowledged her fatlogic.

After a few quick pictures, it was time to get into the limo and head out for the formal photos. The limo in the parking lot on the other side of the church, so we all had to walk across the church lawn to get to it. Since it's autumn now, the lawn was strewn with dead leaves and these tiny mystery fruits that looked like miniature apricots. The Fat Bridesmaid exclaims that it's too hard to walk across the grass in heels, her feet hurt from standing "so long" for the ceremony and the photos, and takes off her shoes. She waddles across the grass, and gets into the limo. I get into the limo too, and the smell hits me like a brick wall; like rotting fruit, but much worse. One of the other bridesmaids exclaims, "it stinks in here." We look over at The Fat Bridesmaid, who is now wiping pieces of rotten fruit from the bottom of her feet, and throwing the used napkins on the floor of the limo. "It was those things on the lawn!" fatty exclaims. We all start checking our shoes for these things, but it seems like she's the only one with any on her. It seems they burst under her massive weight, but just sank into the ground whenver a normal-sized bridesmaid stepped on them.

We get to the first location for our formal photos. The Fat Bridesmaid is still complaining that her feet hurt, and says she is going to wear her flat shoes instead of her heels. My sister (the bride) asks her to wear her heels for the photos, especially since fatty is so much shorter than everyone else in the wedding party. Hamderella pouts, and says she'll carry her heels with her and change into them for the photos.

The photographer does a few photos of my sister and her husband, then a few photos of just the groomsmen. He calls us ladies over for the next shot. "Wait!" exclaims Hamderella, "I have to change into my heels!" So we are all stuck waiting while fatty puts on her heels. Once the photographer gets the shots he wanted, he dismisses us ladies for a few minutes, and takes a few more photos of just the men. The Fat Bridesmaid has found a bench in the meantime, and changed back into her flats. The photographer would now like us all to walk to a different area for some additional shots. Hamderella is still sitting on the bench. "Can't I just sit for a minute?" she whines. "I'm tired from being on my feet all day." My sister (the bride) and the photographer both look annoyed at this point. "We have to keep going or else we won't have enough time to get all the photos I need," the photographer says. We all walk over to the new spot the photographer has picked out (maybe 100 feet from the bench) and have to wait again for Hamderella to change her shoes. Once we were in the limo again, The Fat Bridesmaid insisted on removing her shoes, and kept us all waiting with the shoe-changing routine at the second photo location.

TL;DR: Fat Bridesmaid falls down during photo shoot, tries to grab onto me (who is 3.5 months pregnant!) and almost drags me down with her. Fatty is butthurt that everyone is more concerned about my well-being than hers. Fatty then stinks up the limo with her disgusting hooves because she refuses to wear shoes inside, and also she ran through a bunch of rotted fruit. Then fatty makes everyone wait for her to make multiple shoe-changes during professional photos.
